terms.gloss: without beginning or end, eternal, everlasting
evidence: Cic. Fin. 2.88: deus beātus et aeternus (Lewis & Short)
Cic. Fat. 48: causae immūtābilēs eaeque aeternae (Lewis & Short)

phrases.latin: ut vultūs hominum, ita simulācra vultūs inbēcilla ac mortālia sunt, fōrma mentis aeterna
phrases.english: like men’s faces, the likenesses of their faces are frail and mortal; the form of the mind is eternal
